_comment: MeatPi device catalog — the living source of device-type definitions for the Home Assistant integration (https://github.com/meatpiHQ/ha-wican). Fetched by every install at most once per 24h; validated before merge by validate_catalog.py. Reserved slugs (wican, wican_usb, wican_pro, meatpi) are defined in integration code and cannot be redefined here.
